payload.rationale: Capabilities ['core'] decomposed from the catalog. Independent work runs in parallel (implement.codes, implement.foundation, implement.urls); tests and docs branch after implementation and join at review; release waits for review.

302 by default (307 configurable): 301 is cached forever by browsers, breaking disable/delete and analytics; 7-char random base62 codes with bounded retry: 62^7 = 3.5e12; per-insert collision p = n/62^7; no central counter to coordinate; Soft delete + 410 Gone: keeps audit history and prevents silent alias re-use; Idempotency-Key stored on the link with a request fingerprint: simple, transactional, survives restarts

Everything the feature nodes share is built first so they can proceed in parallel: pydantic-settings config (12-factor, SHORTENER_ prefix), SQLAlchemy 2.0 async engine with a UTC-safe datetime type, Alembic migration 0001 (links table, unique code + idempotency key), JSON logging with request ids, a single error envelope, pure-ASGI middleware (request id, security headers, body size limit) and liveness/readiness probes. Test fixtures migrate a template DB once and copy it per test.

payload.rationale: 7 random base62 characters give 62^7 = 3.5e12 codes; per-insert collision probability is n/62^7, so a bounded retry (5) plus the DB unique constraint is sufficient and avoids a central counter. Aliases are validated by regex (3-32 chars) and checked against reserved route names.

Shorteners are abused for phishing and SSRF-style probing. Only http/https are accepted, embedded credentials are rejected, private/loopback/link-local IP literals and local host names are refused by default (configurable), and the URL is normalised so equivalent inputs store identically.

Target URL validation and normalisation (http/https only, no private hosts, no credentials)

payload.rationale: LinkService holds the use cases; the repository isolates SQL. Create supports Idempotency-Key with a request fingerprint (replay returns the original link, misuse returns 409). Redirect returns 302 by default (307 configurable) with Cache-Control no-store so every click reaches the service. Custom aliases are stored in canonical lower case and alias conflicts are checked case-insensitively. NOTE (deliberate, documented): lookups use exact matching, so an alias created as 'MyLink' is not reachable at /MyLink. This is the seeded defect fixed by the brownfield scenario.
